evidence.quote: The invention provides a photothermographic material comprising a photosensitive silver halide, an organic silver salt, a reducing agent, and a binder on a support. A layer containing the organic silver salt has been formed by using a solid particle dispersion of the organic silver salt and a polymer latex as a main binder, preparing a coating solution of the salt and the binder in an aqueous solvent, and coating the solution, followed by drying.

The present invention provides a photothermographic material having, on at least one side of a support, at least an image forming layer containing a photosensitive silver halide, a non-photosensitive organic silver salt, and a reducing agent for the organic silver salt, and at least one non-photosensitive layer, wherein the material contains a water-soluble magenta dye, and also provides an image forming method.

analysis.heterogeneity: 该聚类包含光热成像材料和热记录材料两种不同技术领域，其中光热成像材料进一步细分为具有特定银碘含量、还原剂组合及图像形成方法的多种类型；热记录材料则集中于热敏显色层的组成。因此存在一定的异质性。
analysis.limitations: 部分文献仅提供标题或摘要，未充分披露具体技术细节，如还原剂种类、聚合物类型等；且部分专利家族中存在重复内容，影响独立证据数量。
